lm.caption: An upbeat, swinging jazz trio performance featuring a prominent, walking upright bass line that establishes a steady, infectious groove. A crisp drum kit with brushed snares and a ride cymbal drives the rhythm forward with a classic swing feel. A clean-toned piano enters, first laying down chords and then weaving melodic fills and improvisational lines that explore the harmonic complexity. The arrangement feels like a live, in-the-moment studio session, with a clean mix and a natural acoustic sound.
